letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my endless sunshine,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this wild, beautiful life with you. Your laughter lights up my days, and your love steadies my heart like the gentle tide. I cherish our late‑night chai talks, our spontaneous desert drives, and the way you call me “cutie” when I try to cook. No matter where we are, you are my home, my forever adventure, and I fall deeper in love with you each passing moment.
poem:
In desert dunes or city rain,  
Your smile erases every strain.  
Together, love, we dance and sway—  
Forever yours, come what may.
